coreMove: Shape communication for how the receiver thinks and decides so the message enters their reasoning instead of staying in the sender perspective.
modernTranslation: Respectful persuasion in the fair reading; manipulation in the unfair reading.

ethicalSplit.legitimate: Audience-aware persuasion that clarifies stakes without distorting the choice.
ethicalSplit.illegitimate: Framing that only works because it conceals its mechanism or overrides informed judgment.
